families.name: SidecarTridge TOS Emulator Family (board revision 3)
families.description: Firmware builds for SidecarTridge TOS Emulator board revision 3 for the Atari ST, STE, and Mega series computers.

firmwares.name: TOS Emulator, board revision 3, for Atari STE and Mega STE (256KB)
firmwares.description: Full 256KB firmware for SidecarTridge TOS Emulator board revision 3 for Atari STE and Mega STE computers.
firmwares.post_install_html:
Unplug the device and plug it into your computer to complete the installation.

The drive now holds SWITCHER 4.0.0 and the rescue switcher 4.0.0. Older copies of the SWITCHER on your floppies or hard disk do not work with this firmware: replace them too. See Getting Started.

firmwares.name: TOS Emulator, board revision 3, for Atari ST and Mega ST (192KB)
firmwares.description: Full 192KB firmware for SidecarTridge TOS Emulator board revision 3 for Atari ST and Mega ST computers.
firmwares.post_install_html:
Unplug the device and plug it into your computer to complete the installation.

The drive now holds SWITCHER 4.0.0 and the rescue switcher 4.0.0. Older copies of the SWITCHER on your floppies or hard disk do not work with this firmware: replace them too. See Getting Started.

firmwares.name: TOS Emulator, board revision 3, upgrade for all Atari models
firmwares.description: Upgrade firmware for SidecarTridge TOS Emulator board revision 3 for all Atari ST, STE, and Mega series computers.
firmwares.post_install_html:
Unplug the device and plug it into your computer to complete the installation.

Coming from firmware v3.x? The update keeps your ROM images, but you must also replace the SWITCHER and the rescue switcher on the ROMEMUL drive with the 4.0.0 versions, or they stop at an incompatibility screen. Step by step: Upgrading to v4.0.0.
